prompt:
A simple flat 2D vector game item icon of a cute round orange 
fruit mascot. Plump teardrop-shaped orange body, two pointed 
green leaves on top like ears, a small brown stem between them. 
Two small white oval eyes, short brown eyebrow marks above them, 
a tiny w-shaped mouth, two short stubby arms. Solid flat color 
fills only — one orange, one green, one brown, nothing more. 
Thick uniform dark brown outline around every shape. Completely 
flat with zero shading, zero highlights, zero gradients, zero 
texture. Sticker or clip art look, facing forward, centered. 
Not a 3D render, not a photograph.
